features.label: X overall [145 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws: between the left short-arm end and the right long-arm end. Full horizontal span. This is the new 145 mm stepped cross, not the old grid gauge.

features.label: X short depth [30 mm]
features.help: Depth rod from the left short-arm end to the left side of the vertical arm; guide along the lower edge of the short arm. Seat the sole on the end face and the rod on the flat target beside the relief. This is a depth measurement, not an outside width.

features.label: X long depth [100 mm]
features.help: Depth rod from the right tip to the right side of the upper arm, along the straight upper edge. Seat the sole on the tip and the rod on the flat target beside the corner relief.

features.label: X crossing width [15 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws across the vertical short arm, in the X direction. This 15 mm width closes the short-depth + crossing-width + long-depth = overall chain.

features.label: X width at tip [15 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws across the tip of the vertical long arm. Measure in X, perpendicular to that arm. The engraved 15 identifies the section.

features.label: X width middle [25 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws across the middle section of the vertical long arm. Measure in X, perpendicular to that arm. The engraved 25 identifies the section.

features.label: X width wide [35 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws across the wide root section of the vertical long arm. Measure in X, perpendicular to that arm. The engraved 35 identifies the section.

features.label: X compound span [85 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws from the left face of the vertical arm to the outer/middle junction of the horizontal long arm, below its straight bottom edge.

features.label: X root section [30 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws along the horizontal long arm: measure the two opposite ends of its widest section. This interval uses outside jaws; it is not one of the depth steps.

features.label: X middle step [30 mm]
features.help: Depth rod along the horizontal long arm, between the two successive step/end planes bounding the middle section. Guide beside the stepped edge, with the sole on the farther-out plane.

features.label: X tip step [30 mm]
features.help: Depth rod along the horizontal long arm, between the two successive step/end planes bounding the tip section. Guide beside the stepped edge, with the sole on the farther-out plane.

features.label: X window length [45 mm]
features.help: Inside jaws along the horizontal window, between its flat end faces. Avoid the corner reliefs and top/bottom chamfers. This is the X internal length.

features.label: X window width [10 mm]
features.help: Inside jaws across the vertical window, in X. Avoid the corner reliefs and chamfers. The window in the other arm supplies this 10 mm measurement along the selected axis.

features.label: X straight wall [7.5 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws across the material between the straight outside edge of the vertical long arm and the adjacent window face. One jaw enters the window. Measure in X, away from corner reliefs.

features.label: X wide wall [17.5 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws across the material between the widest stepped outside edge of the vertical long arm and the adjacent window face. One jaw enters the window. Measure in X, away from corner reliefs.

features.label: X middle wall [7.5 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws across the material between the middle stepped outside edge of the vertical long arm and the adjacent window face. One jaw enters the window. Measure in X, away from corner reliefs.

features.label: Y overall [145 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws: between the upper short-arm end and the lower long-arm end. Full vertical span. This is the new 145 mm stepped cross, not the old grid gauge.

features.label: Y short depth [30 mm]
features.help: Depth rod from the upper short-arm end to the top side of the horizontal arm; guide along the left edge of the short arm. Seat the sole on the end face and the rod on the flat target beside the relief. This is a depth measurement, not an outside width.

features.label: Y long depth [100 mm]
features.help: Depth rod from the lower tip to the bottom side of the right arm, along the straight right edge. Seat the sole on the tip and the rod on the flat target beside the corner relief.

features.label: Y crossing width [15 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws across the horizontal short arm, in the Y direction. This 15 mm width closes the short-depth + crossing-width + long-depth = overall chain.

features.label: Y width at tip [15 mm]

features.label: Y width middle [25 mm]

features.label: Y width wide [35 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws across the wide root section of the horizontal long arm. Measure in Y, perpendicular to that arm. The engraved 35 identifies the section.

features.label: Y compound span [85 mm]
features.help: Outside jaws from the top face of the left short arm to the middle/tip junction of the vertical long arm.

features.label: Y root section [30 mm]
